programs.name: Business Services Training Program (BSTP)

source.note: This is the ONLY undergraduate-facing Latham program found on the firm's own domain. It is a full-time post-graduation rotational business-services role (non-lawyer), not a legal internship. The London Placement variant is open to current university students on a year in industry.

class_year.quote: The Business Services Training Program (BSTP) is a highly selective rotational program for recent university graduates seeking hands-on experience across business functions at Latham.

process.quote: We encourage interested candidates to register their interest to receive updates and application reminders.

cooling_off.notes: No reapplication or cooling-off language on the page.

programs.cycle: Typically two years (London: one year); applications open Autumn 2026
programs.location: US: Chicago, Los Angeles — GSO, New York, Washington, D.C. UK: London, Manchester

programs.name: BSTP — London Placement variant

source.note: Recorded separately because it is the only Latham program on the firm's own domain open to CURRENTLY ENROLLED undergraduates. UK-only.

class_year.quote: A one-year program designed for current university students completing a year-in-industry between their second and final years.

programs.cycle: One-year placement between second and final years of university

programs.name: 1L Fellowship / 1L Diversity Scholars Program

source.note: The firm's own vanity URL lw.com/1LFellowship now resolves to a "Belong As You Are" inclusion page that contains NO fellowship eligibility criteria, deadlines, or stipend. The law-school page law.utexas.edu/careers/scholarships/latham-watkins-1l-fellowship-program/ returns HTTP 404. The only current firm-domain evidence that a 1L track exists at all is the summer program page line "Our 2026 1L and 2027 2L applications are closed." No verbatim eligibility text is currently published on any tier-1 or reachable tier-2 source, so all fields are left unverified rather than filled from aggregator summaries.

programs.cycle: Historically a 1L summer program; current status unverified
